items.reason: The email names Priya's real pains (missed oil changes, DOT inspections slipping) and interests (auto-reminders, driver app), gives one next step (trial link plus pricing sheet), and stays casual.
It invents no details about Mike's company, pains or commitments, and uses clear placeholders for the missing specifics.
It neither claims a Samsara integration nor promises the 30% discount, says the rep is checking on both, and ends with a single ask for a call.

It does focus on north depot downtime and the CFO, but it swaps the promised ROI one-pager for a Monday call where Carla has to bring her own numbers, so the next step isn't delivering the summary before Tuesday.
